v: Ha in Oseas in tik, yuninal in winhaj Beeri, ix lolon Jehová t'ayin ayik ix yak'an reyal heb' winh tik t'a chonhab' Judá: Haton winhaj Uzías, winhaj Jotam, winhaj Acaz yet' winhaj Ezequías. Haxo t'a Israel a winhaj Jeroboam yuninal winhaj Joás ayoch reyal. Haton t'a tik tz'ib'ab'ilkan tas ix yal Jehová t'ayin.

Ayik ix scha'anel yich Jehová slolon t'ayin, ix yalan icha tik: Ha heb' etisraelal, te chuk sk'ulej heb' t'a wichanh, ix yik'el sb'a heb' t'ayin icha junok ix ajmul ix. Yuj chi', a junok ix ajmul ix tzik' etb'eyumok. Ay heb' yune' ix ol aljok t'a yajmulal, xchi t'ayin.
Yuj chi' ix wik' ix skuchan Gomer yisil winhaj Diblaim wetb'eyumok. Ixlajwi chi' ix skuchanoch yune' ix, ix alji jun in winak unin yet' ix.

Ix yalan Jehová t'ayin icha tik: Jezreel ol ak' sb'i'ej winh unin chi', yujto t'a yik jaye' k'uhal tik, ol wak'och syahelal heb' yinhtilal winhaj rey Jehú yuj jantak anima ix smilcham heb' t'a chonhab' Jezreel. Ol wak'pax lajwokel chonhab' Israel chi'.
Ha t'a jun k'uhal chi', ol in satel heb' soldado Israel t'a lum sch'olanil Jezreel chi', xchi t'ayin.

Ix skuchanxi'och yune' ix Gomer chi', ix unin jun yune' ix, ix alji. Ix yalan Jehová t'ayin icha tik: “Manh-xajanab'ilok” tzak' sb'i'ej ix isil chi', yujto manhxo ol ok' in k'ol t'a chonhab' Israel tik. Manhxo ol wak'laj niwank'olal.

Haxo pax chonhab' Judá, ol ok' in k'ol t'ay. Ha in Jehová in sDiosal in heb' ol in kolo', palta manhok yet' heb' soldado ayk'e t'a yib'anh chej yet'nak syamk'ab' yik owal, palta yet' in poder ol in kol heb', xchi.
Haxo yik toxo ix el ix unin chi' t'a yim, ix skuchanxi'och yune' ix Gomer chi', ix alji junxo swinak unin ix.
Ix yalanxi Jehová t'ayin icha tik: “Manh-in-chonhab'ok”, icha chi' tzak' sb'i'ej winh unin chi', yujto a ex israel ex tik, manhxo in chonhab'ok eyaji, manhxo in he Diosalok.

Palta ay wal jun k'uhal, lajan ol ajxi sb'isul heb' israel tik icha yarena'il sti' ha' mar, malaj mach syal sb'isani. Ha b'aj ix wal t'a heb' icha tik: “Manh-ex-in-chonhab'ok”, xin chi, hata' ol alchaj t'a heb': Yuninal ex Dios pitzan.
Ol smolb'ej sb'a heb' aj Judá yet' heb' aj Israel t'a jun pekti' chi', junxonhej yajalil heb' ol yak'ochi. Ol te k'echa'anh heb', yujto te niwan yelk'och jun k'uhal yik Jezreel chi'.
Al t'a heb' etchonhab' icha tik: Schonhab' Dios kaji, xajan onh yuj, xa chi, xchi Jehová.

Ix yalan Jehová t'ayin to swak'och in b'a ch'oxnab'ilok yet' heb' wuninal yet' pax ix snun heb', yuj chi' ix walan icha tik t'a heb' unin chi': Ha ix he nun chi' manhxo wetb'eyumok ix, manhxo in yetb'eyumok pax ix, palta alek t'a ix to maxtzak yak'och sb'a ix ajmulal, yaktejokab'kan heb' winh sk'uman ix chi'.
Tato hanheja' sk'ulan ix icha chi', ol wak' k'ixwelal ix, ol wik'el spichul ix, ol kan b'eran ix icha yik ix alji. Ichawal takinh lum ol ajkan ix wu'uj, ol champax ix yuj takinhti'al.
Manh ol ok'paxlaj in k'ol t'ayex, yujto yune' ex ix t'a yajmulal.

Ha ix he nun chi', ix och ix ajmulal. Ix ixtaxel swach'ilal ix ayik ix yalan ix icha tik: Ol b'at in say mach nib'ab'il wu'uj, mach tz'ak'an in wa'el yet' tas swuk'ej, mach tz'ak'an in lana yet' in lino, in perfume yet' in wino, xchi ix.
Yuj chi' ichato ol in mak sb'e ix t'a te' k'i'ix, ol wak'anoch makte' t'a spatiktak, yuj chi' manhxo ol ilchaj sb'e ix b'aj ol b'atok.

Ol b'at tzak'an ix t'a spatik mach snib'ej chi', palta manh ol yamchaj yuj ix. Ol sayek' ix, palta manhxo ol ilchaj yuj ix. Yuj chi' ol yalan ix icha tik: Ol in meltzaj t'a winh wik'nak t'a sb'ab'elal. Wach'taxon waj yet' winh t'a yichanh icha tikne'ik, xcham ix, xin chi t'a heb'.

Yuj tas sk'ulej heb' wetisraelal chi', yuj chi' ix yal Jehová icha tik: Maj yojtakejel heb' tato a in swak' strigo heb', swino heb' yet' sperfume heb' to a in swak' niwanb'ok k'e'en plata yet' k'e'en oro t'a heb', haxo t'a juntzanh komon Dios ix yak' heb'.
Yuj chi' ol wik'ek' ixim in trigo yet' in wino, ol wik'anpaxek' nok' in lana yet' in lino tz'och spichulok heb'.
K'elanoch juntzanh chonhab' ix montanb'at yik syal sb'a heb' t'a skomon diosal, ol wak'an k'ixwok heb'. Manhxa mach ol kolanel heb' t'a yol in k'ab'.
Ol wak' lajwok stzalajk'olal heb' yuj k'inh yik tz'alji k'e'en uj yet' t'a sk'uhal ik'oj ip yet' masanil juntzanhxo k'inh tz'ochtaxoni.

Ha heb' israel ix halani: Ha juntzanh komon Dios ix ak'an sat te' uwa yet' te' higo stojolok b'aj ix kak'em ko b'a, xchi heb'. Yuj chi' a in Jehová in ol in satel juntzanh te' uwa yet' te' higo chi'. Ha b'aj awab'il chi' ol wak'och wayumtakil, haxo nok' kaltakte'al nok' ol ab'lanb'at awb'en chi'.

Ha in Jehová in swala' to ol wak'och yahelal t'a yib'anh heb', yujto niwan tiempo ix yaltej incienso heb' t'a juntzanh yechel Baal. Ix laj sb'o'an sb'a heb' icha junok ix ix syak'och yuchikin yet' stonh tz'och tzak'an yuj heb' winh nib'ab'il yuj, syak'an sat sk'o'ol t'a winh yetb'eyum. Icha chi' in yutej chonhab' Israel tik.
Wach'chom icha chi' ix sk'ulej chonhab' Israel tik, palta ol in montej, ol wik'anxib'at t'a tzinan lu'um. Hata' ol wal wach' lolonel t'ay.

Ol wak'anxi slu'um b'aj awab'il yuwa. Ha sch'olanil ilk'olal ol wak'och sch'olanil yipk'olal. Icha yaj t'a sb'ab'elal ayik yelnakkot t'a Egipto icha chi' ol wutokxikani. Hata' ol tak'wok t'ayin, ichawal sk'ulej junok ix kob'es ix.
Ha in Jehová in swala' to ha t'a jun k'uhal chi', ol in yal yetb'eyumok. Manhxo ol yal jun chonhab' tik to Baal waj t'ay.
Junelnhej ol wik'el t'a sti' yak'an b'inaj juntzanh Baal, manhxa b'ak'inh ol yak' b'inajok.

Ha t'a jun k'uhal chi', ol wak' in trato yet' nok' kaltakte'al nok', nok' much yet' nok' chan, yik manhxalaj tas ol utaj yuj nok'. T'a junelnhej ol wik'kanel k'e'en lanza t'a jun chonhab' tik yet' juntzanhxo yamk'ab' yik owal, yik wach' ol yik' yip in chonhab' tik, manhxa tas ol sna'a.
Ach chonhab' Israel, ichato ol ach wik' t'a junelnhej. Toton wal icha wetb'eyum ol ach aj t'a stojolal yet' t'a smojalil, yujto ol ok' wal och in k'ol t'ayach yet' ach in xajanani.
Ichato ol ach wik'a', ol in k'ulejnhej tas ix wala', ichato chi' ol in ojtakaneli to Jehová in.
Ha in Jehová in swala': Ha t'a jun k'uhal chi', ol in tak'wok t'ayach, ol wal t'a satcha'anh, haxo satcha'anh chi' ol ak'ankot nhab' t'a sat lu'um.
Ol yak'an ixim trigo lum lum, wino yet' aceite. Ichawal chi' ol aj in pakan slesal in chonhab' b'ob'il wu'uj.

Ol wak'xi kajnaj in chonhab' t'a sat lum lum tik yik tz'och wet'ok. Ol ok' in k'o'ol t'a ix “Manh-xajanab'ilok” yet' t'a winhaj “Manh-in-chonhab'ok”, ol walan icha tik: In chonhab' ach, xin chama. Haxo ol halan t'ayin: In Diosal ach, xchama, xchi Jehová.

Ix yalan Jehová t'ayin icha tik: Xajanejxi ix etb'eyum, wach'chom smulan ix yet' mach snib'ej. Icha chi' ol utok a ch'oxani tas tz'aj in xajanan heb' etisraelal, wach'chom syak'och spensar heb' t'a komon Dios yet' yik'anb'at takinh uwa heb' silab'ok t'a juntzanh komon Dios chi', xchi t'ayin.
Yuj chi', ix in mananxi ix t'a 15 siclo k'e'en plata yet' chanhe' quintal ixim cebada yik tz'ochxi ix wetb'eyumok.

Ix walan t'a ix icha tik: Najtil ol in a tanhwej t'a in pat t'a ichnhej ta'. Manhxo ach och ajmulal, manhxo altej a b'a t'a junokxo winak. Hanhejtona' in, ol in tanhwej yek' jun pekti' chi', malaj pax junokxo ix ol in saya', ichato chi' ol kik'lanxi ko b'a, xin chi t'a ix.

Icha pax chi' chonhab' Israel, najtil ol ek' t'a ichnhej ta', malaj sreyal, malaj pax yajalil. Manhxo ol snhuslaj silab' t'ayin, manhxalaj k'e'en k'e'en b'aj ol yak' silab' heb' t'a juntzanh komon Dios. Manhxalaj pichul yik heb' sacerdote, manhxalaj komon Dios t'a yol spat junjun heb'.

Ol lajwok chi' jun, ha t'a slajwub' k'uhal, ol meltzajxok heb'. Ol in yalanxi heb' sDiosalok, ol scha'an junok yinhtilal winhaj David heb' sreyalok. Icha chi' ol aj yoch heb' ejmelal t'a wichanh a in Jehová in tik yet' scha'an swach'il heb' tas ol wak'a'.

Ex wetisraelal, ab'ek slolonel Jehová. Wan yalan Jehová chi' t'a yib'anh masanil anima kajan t'a jun chonhab' tik, yujto manhxalaj mach tz'elk'och tas syala'. Manhxalaj mach wach'to spensar, manhxalaj mach syak'och spensar t'ay.
Sk'echa'anh heb' sk'exan sti' t'a tas syala', syesan heb'. Smilwaj heb', tz'elk'an heb', anhej ajmulal sk'ulej heb'. Slaj yixtej yetanima'il heb', kotak skal smilancham anima heb'.
Yuj chi', a slum jun chonhab' tik, ol kan tzinan. Ha heb' kajan t'ay, manhxalaj yip heb'. Ol cham nok' kaltakte'al nok', nok' much yet' masanil nok' chay ay t'a yoltak ha ha'.
Syalan Jehová t'ayin icha tik: Malajokab' mach skot yowal t'a heb' chonhab' tik, yujto a mach ay wowal yet'ok haton eyet' ex sacerdote.
Yuj chi', ha t'a k'uhalil ol ex telwok icha t'ak'walil. Ol telwok pax heb' in chekab' heyet'ok. Ha in ol wak' lajwok chonhab' Israel to icha he nun yaji.

Ol in satel jun in chonhab' tik, yujto manhxo in na'anok yuj. Ha exxo ex sacerdote, yelxo maxtzak in he na'a. Yuj chi' ol ex wik'el t'a eyopisio. Yujto ix b'at in k'ayb'ub'al satk'olal eyu'uj, yuj chi' manhxo ol in nakot heb' eyinhtilal.
Icha ix aj sk'ib' he b'isul ex sacerdote, icha chi' ix aj sk'echa'anh smul in chonhab'. Yuj chi' a he b'inajnakil, k'ixwelaltak ol wutejkani.
Yuj silab' syak' in chonhab' yuj smul, wach' he wa'i, yuj chi' tze nib'ej to tz'ochnhej smul in chonhab' tik t'ayin.
Yuj chi' lajan ol aj yab'an sya'il heb' in chonhab' heyet'ok a ex sacerdote ex tik. Yuj he b'eyb'al chi' ol wak'och yahelal t'a eyib'anh yet' heb'.

Yujto maxtzak in yak' serwil heb' in chonhab', haxo jun komon Dios skuch Baal syak' serwil heb'. Wach'chom swa heb', sway heb' yet' heb' ix ajmul ix t'a stemplo skomon diosal chi', palta manh yujok chi' niwan ol satan smunlajel heb', manh ol k'ib'pax sb'isul heb'.
Yuj yajmulal heb' yet' yuk'umanhil heb', yuj chi' ix kistalax spensar heb'.

Ha t'a junok te te' sk'anb'ej yab' heb' in chonhab' tik tas sk'ulej heb'. Haxo te te' chi' tz'ak'an srazón heb' yalani. Yuj yajmulal heb' chi', yuj chi' ix juwi'el heb'. Icha wal tz'aj yaktankan winh yetb'eyum junok ix ix, smulan yet' junokxo winak, icha chi' ix in yutej heb', sb'atkan tzak'an heb' yuj komon Dios.

Ha t'a jolomtak witz yet' t'a tzalkixtak, hata' snhus incienso heb' yet' yak'an silab' heb' t'a yalanh yenhul xil te' álamo, te' ji yet' te' mach'. Yuj chi', slaj em heb' ix eyisil yet' heb' ix eyalib' t'a ajmulal.

Palta manh ol wak'ochlaj syahelal heb' ix eyisil yet' heb' ix eyalib' yuj yajmulal chi', yujto a ex jun tze k'ulej ajmulal chi', tzeyak'an silab' yet' heb' ix ix sb'eyb'alan ajmulal. Yuj chi', a jun chonhab' malaj spensar tik, ol ixtaxelok.

Wach'chom ix och smul chonhab' Israel, palta mokab' och smul chonhab' Judá. Mokab' b'at och heb' ejmelal t'a Gilgal, mokab' k'epax heb' t'a Bet-awén. Mokab' slok in b'i heb' a in Jehová pitzan in tik.
Ha chonhab' Israel, te pit, lajan wal icha junok nok' wakax te ow. Tato icha chi', ¿tom ol yal in tanhwan heb' icha junok nok' yune' kalnel b'aj yax ank'ultak?
Haxo chonhab' Efraín ix och tzak'an yuj juntzanh komon Dios, palta olxo yil sb'a.

Masanil heb' syal sb'a t'a juntzanh komon Dios, tzek' tzuyjab' heb' t'a skal heb' yetuk'umanhil. Maxtzak yaktej heb' sk'ulan ajmulal. Ha heb' yajalil heb', a tas k'ixwelaltak snib'ej heb' sk'ulan t'a yichanh to tz'alji heb' wach'il.
Icha tz'aj yik'chajb'at k'alem yuj ik', icha chi' ol aj yik'chajb'at heb'. Malaj ol yak' yal heb' yuj juntzanh silab' syak' t'a juntzanh skomon diosal chi'.

Ab'ek wal juntzanh tik ex sacerdote. Maklejek eyab' ex chonhab' Israel. Ab'ek pax ex yinhtilal ex heb' rey: Ha t'a eyib'anh a ex tik ol och jun yahelal tik, yujto a ex tik, icha junok ch'anh ya'al heyaj t'a Mizpa yet' t'a jolom witz Tabor.
Tzijtum anima ix he mak'cham yuj he pitalil, yuj chi' ol wak'och yahelal t'a eyib'anh.
Ex israel ayex t'a yol yik Efraín, wojtak tas eyaji. ¿Tom tze na'a to manh wojtakok tas heyaj chi'? Ix eyak'och he b'a ajmulal, ix eyixtejel he b'a t'a yajb'entakil.
Yuj he chuk b'eyb'al chi', max yal he meltzajkot t'ayin. Anhej t'a juntzanh komon Dios tzeyal he b'a. Yuj wal to he gana he k'ulan ajmulal, yuj chi' maxtzak in he na jab'ok.
Ex aj Efraín, a eyik'ojchanhb'a'il sch'oxanel he chukalil. Ex aj Israel, munil ol ex telwok yuj eyajmulal chi'. Yet' ex aj Judá lajan ol aj he telwi yet' heb'.
Ol b'at in he sayek'i, eyet'nak nok' he kalnel yet' nok' he wakax yik tzeyak' silab'il t'ayin. Palta manhxo ol in ilchajlaj eyu'uj, yujto toxo ix wik'el in b'a t'a he kal.
Yujto te chuk ix eyutej he b'a t'ayin, ay eyuninal mitz' unin yaji. Yuj chi' ha t'a k'inh ayik tz'alji k'e'en uj, hata' ol ex satel yet' he munlajel.
Puchajokab' nok' ch'a'ak yik owal t'a Gabaa, puchajokab'pax k'e'en trompeta t'a Ramá. Awajanhek t'a Bet-awén. Ayokab' xiwk'olal t'a skal heb' anima yik Benjamín.
Ha in swal t'a skal masanil heb' yinhtil Israel yuj tas yowalil ol jawok t'a yib'anh heb': Ha heb' aj Efraín, ol lajwokel heb' yuj yahelal ol jawok t'a jun k'uhal chi'.
Ha in Jehová in swala': Ha heb' yajal t'a Judá, lajan heb' icha juntzanh anima tz'ik'ancha'anh tz'aka'anh, yuj chi' ol in satel heb' yet' yowal in k'o'ol.
Ha chonhab' Efraín tik, toxo ix ja t'a yib'anh. Manhxalaj tas ay t'ay, yujto ix yak'och t'a sk'ol yoch tzak'an yuj juntzanh komon Dios.
Ha in ol wixtejb'at chonhab' Efraín icha tz'aj yixtax junok tas yuj nok' ha'ay. Ol wixtanb'at chonhab' Judá icha tz'aj sk'ab'at junok tas.

Ayik ix yilan chonhab' Efraín to ya ay, ix yilanpax yechen Judá, ix b'at chonhab' Efraín chi' t'a Asiria sk'an skolwal jun rey b'inajnak yak'an owal, palta maj yal-laj yuj jun rey chi' yak'an b'oxok sk'o'ol, maj yalpaxlaj yanhtan yechen chi'.

Icha wal tz'aj smakwaj junok nok' choj, icha chi' ol aj in makwaj t'a chonhab' Efraín yet' t'a chonhab' Judá. Ha in ol in chok' tzilejb'at heb', ol waktankan heb' b'i'an, haxo in b'at chi'. Ol in tzak'cha'anh heb', manhxa mach ol yal skolan heb' t'a yol in k'ab'.
Haxo in meltzaj chi' t'a elanhchamel b'aj kajan in masanto ol yojtakejel smul heb', haxo sjawi heb' chi' yal sb'a t'ayin. Ha t'a skal syahelal heb' chi', ol yal sb'a heb' t'ayin t'a smasanil sk'o'ol.
Ol yal heb' chonhab' icha tik: Kotanhek he masanil, konh meltzajek t'a Jehová. Ha ix onh chok'tzilanb'ati, hanheja' ol onh anhtanpaxok. Ix onh yak' echnajok, hanheja' a ol anhtanpax kechen chi'.
Ha wal yek'b'at chab' k'uhal, ichato chi' ol yak'an ko k 'inal. Haxo t'a yoxil k'uhal, ol onh yak'anpax pitzwok, ol onh kajnaj t'a yichanh.

Kak'ek kip kojtakanel Jehová. Icha kojtakaneli to ol sakb'ok, kojtak to ol jax t'ayonh tato sko na ko b'a. Ol yak'kot swach'k'olal t'a kib'anh, icha tz'aj syaxb'i sat lum lum yuj b'ab'el nhab' yet' slajwub' nhab'ilk'inal, xcham heb'.

Icha tik yalan Jehová: ¿Tas wach' ol ex wutok ex aj Efraín? ¿Tas wach' ol ex wutok ex aj Judá? Ha b'aj tzin he xajanej, lajan icha asun t'a k'inhib'alil, lajan icha yal ak'wal t'a ayto sk'inhib'i, haxo sk'inhib'i, satemi.
Yuj in lolonel ix wak' yal heb' in chekab', ol ex in sateli. Niwan chekel ol aj eyahelal chi' icha wal yok k'u.
Ha wal tas in gana tze k'ulej to tz'ok' he k'ol t'a eyetanima'il yet' in eyojtakaneli to he Diosal in, manhoknhej he nhusantz'a silab' t'ayin in gana.
Ha ex in chonhab' ex tik, maj he k'anab'ajej in trato heyet'ok, icha yutejnak sb'a winhaj Adán. Chuk ix eyutej he b'a t'ayin.
Ha heb' anima t'a chonhab' Galaad, anhej chukal sk'ulej heb', masanil b'aj ay chik' yuj b'aj smilwaj heb'.
Ha heb' sacerdote, icha junok molanh elk'um yek' heb'. Smak anima heb' yik smak'anchamok. T'a sb'e'al Siquem smak'wicham anima heb', sk'ulanpax masanil chukal heb'.
Ha heb' aj Efraín ix och heb' ajmulal. Ix yixtejb'at sb'a heb' yet' heb' yetisraelal. Yuj chi' te yajb'entak yilji heb' swila'.
Yet' ex pax ex aj Judá, wan sjawi sk'uhal eyahelal. Tzin nib'ej tzin k'ex tas ayoch t'a yib'anh in chonhab' Israel,

palta ayik wan wanhtan in chonhab' Efraín yet' Samaria walani, hata' snachajel smul heb' yet' schukal heb' wu'uj. Yujto junlajanxonhej tz'aj sb'eyb'alan es heb'. Elk'um heb' smasanil, tz'och heb' elk'al t'a yoltak pat yet' t'a yoltak calle.
Tokwal sna heb' tato na'an schukal heb' chi' wu'uj. Ha tikne'ik a tas sk'ulej heb' a oyanoch t'a spatik yichanh heb', yuj chi' anhej schukal heb' chi' swila'.
Ha heb' rey yet' heb' yajal ste tzalaj heb' yuj chukal yet' yuj yixtum anima'il heb'.
Anhej ajmulal sb'o heb' smasanil. Ha tas snib'ej heb' chi', lajan icha junok horno jab'nhej sk'ak'al tz'ochi yakb'an spajb'i ixim harina, haxo yik toxo ix pajb'i ixim, tz'och sk'ak'al sik'lab'il.

Ayik tz'och k'inh yuj winh rey, a heb' ayoch t'a yopisio yet' winh, syuk' anh heb', syak'an anh heb' yuk' winh masanto sk'e anh t'a sjolom winh yet' heb'. Tonhej skomon tzalaj winh yet' heb' sb'uchwaj t'ay.
Aynhejoch chuk pensaril t'a spensar heb'. Lajan yowal heb' icha sk'ak'al junok horno pilan ak'wal ayoch sk'ak'al, haxo sk'inhib'i t'a junxo k'u, spukhajxi chakb'ok.
Lajan heb' smasanil icha sk'ak'al horno chi', ix satel winh yajalil heb' yuj yowal chi'. Lajan syutej sb'a heb' t'a smasanil heb' sreyal, palta malaj junok heb' sk'anb'an t'ayin tas smoj sk'ulej.
Ha chonhab' Efraín toxo ix skalej sb'a yet' juntzanh ch'ok chonhab'il. Lajan heb' icha junok ixim wa'il max sutchaji.
Ha heb' ch'ok chonhab'il ix ak'an lajwok yip, palta max yil-laj tas wan yutaji. Ha xil sjolom toxo ix sakb'i'eli, tokwal syilochi.
Ha in Jehová sDiosal in heb' israel. Wach'chom jantak tas ix ja t'a yib'anh heb' yuj schukal, palta yuj yak'umtakil heb' maxtzak sna sb'a sk'ol heb' smeltzajkot t'ayin.
Ha chonhab' Efraín malaj jab'ok spensar, jun rato sb'at sk'an kolwal t'a Egipto, haxo t'a junxo rato sb'atxi sk'an kolwal t'a Asiria. Lajan icha junok nok' uch tonhej sat b'eyek'ok.
Palta ayik ol b'at heb' ta', ol in yumb'at in ch'anh ya'al t'a yib'anh heb'. Ol telwok heb' icha junok nok' much. Ol wak'och yahelal t'a yib'anh heb', icha ix aj yalchaj b'aj smolb'ej sb'a heb'.
Ob'iltak heb', yujto ix in spatikejel heb'. Ol satel heb' yuj yahelal ol jawok, yujto ix och spitalil heb' t'ayin. Tzin nib'ej tzin kol heb', palta manh yelok tas syal heb' t'ayin.
Manh smasanilok sk'ol heb' tzin yawtej ayik tz'el yaw heb' t'a sat sch'at. Spol sb'a heb' yik sk'anan heb' t'a Baal yik wach' tz'aj strigo heb', yet' yuwa heb'. Yuj chi' tz'och heb' ajk'olal t'ayin.
Ix in k'ayb'ej heb', ix wak'anpax yip heb', palta haxo heb', a chukal sna heb' t'a in patik.

Smeltzaj heb' palta manhoklaj t'ayin, a in to Ha inxonhej Ochi. Icha junok jul-lab' koxo, max yamchajlaj tas sjulchaj chi' yet'ok, icha chi' heb'. Yuj yak'umtakil slolon heb' yajalil, yuj chi' ol cham heb' yuj k'e'en espada. Haxo heb' aj Egipto, toxonhej ol b'uchwaj heb' t'a heb'.

Puchajokab' k'e'en trompeta, yujto sjawi juknaj heb' ajk'ol t'a yib'anh in chonhab' icha junok nok' ch'akb'a, yujto maj sk'anab'ajej in trato heb' ix wak' yet'ok. Ix spitej sb'a heb' t'a in k'ayb'ub'al.
Wach'chom syal heb' t'ayin: Ko Diosal ach, tzach kojtakejeli, xchi heb',
palta a heb' israel, toxo ix spatikejel heb' tas wach', yuj chi' ol pechchaj heb' yuj heb' yajk'o'ol.

Ayik ix yak'anoch sreyal heb', maj sk'anb'ej heb' t'ayin mach tz'ochi. Ix say yajalil heb', palta manhok junok sik'b'ilel wu'uj. Ix sb'ok'e sdiosal heb' yet' k'e'en splata yet' k'e'en yoro. Yuj chi' syik'kot heb' t'a yib'anh.
Tzin yaj jun wakax b'ob'il t'a k'e'en oro b'aj tz'och heb' aj Samaria ejmelal. Yuj chi' te aykot wowal t'a heb'. Machekel b'ak'inh ol yaktej heb' israel sk'ulan jun chukal chi'.
Manh diosok jun yechel wakax chi' yujto b'ob'il yuj junok b'o'um yechel. Yuj chi' ol mak'jok wekchajok.

Chuk tas ix sk'ulej heb', yuj chi' te niwan yahelal ol jawok t'a yib'anh heb'. Malaj yawb'en heb' ol sjach'a', malaj harina ol yik' heb' t'a sjolom strigo. Wach'chom ay jab'ok ol yik' heb' jun, haxo heb' ch'ok chonhab'il ol wa'anb'at t'a heb'.
Ha chonhab' Israel ol ak'chaj lajwok. Manhxa jab'ok ol aj yelk'och t'a yol sat juntzanhxo chonhab', icha junok lum k'a chen manhxa wach' yochi, icha chi' ol ajok.

Malaj spensar heb', lajan heb' icha junok nok' kaltakte'al b'uru anhej sna'an b'aj sb'ati. Ix b'at heb' t'a Asiria, ix stupan heb' yik skolwaj yet' heb'. Icha junok ix ix syaktejkan winh yetb'eyum, stupan junok winh snib'ej, icha chi' ix yutej sb'a heb'.
Wach'chom stup juntzanhxo chonhab' heb' yik skolji heb' yuj, a in Jehová in ol in molb'ej heb', yik syab'an sya'il heb' yuj junok rey te ay yip.
Ha heb' aj chonhab' Efraín, tzijtum altar ix sb'ok'e heb' b'aj syak' silab' heb' yik tz'el smul heb' yalani, palta yuj juntzanh altar chi' ste och smul heb'.
Wach'chom tzijtum k'ayb'ub'al ix wak' tz'ib'chaj t'a heb', palta komon lolonel ix ajkan t'a yol sat heb'.
Syak' silab' heb' t'ayin, schi'anpax schib'ejal nok' heb', palta max in tzalaj yet' heb'. Na'an schukal heb' wu'uj. Ol wak'anoch yahelal t'a yib'anh heb'. Ol wak'xi meltzaj heb' t'a Egipto.

Ha heb' israel sb'ok'e cuartel heb' b'aj skol sb'a, palta manhxo in na'anok yuj heb', wach'chom a in ix in b'o heb'. Ha Judá tzijtum chonhab' ayoch smuro'al sb'ok'e'i, palta ol in nhustz'a schonhab', yet' scuartel chi', xchi Jehová.

Ex wetisraelal manh ex tzalajok, manh ex k'e chennaj yuj tzalajk'olal icha heb' ch'ok chonhab'il, yujto ix eyaktejkan ko Diosal, icha tz'aj yaktankan yetb'eyum heb' ix ajmul ix. Tzex te tzalaj he ch'oxani to xajan Baal eyu'uj, yujto wach' tz'aj sat tas tzeyawej yuj eyalani.
Yuj chi' manhxalaj ixim trigo yet' sat te' uwa ol he molo'. Ha he wino ak'to manhxo ol yab'laj.
Manhxo ol yal-laj heyaj t'a schonhab' Jehová. Ayex ol ex meltzaj t'a Egipto, ayex ol ex b'at t'a Asiria. Ha tas yajb'entak t'a yichanh Jehová ol he wa ta'.

Manhxo ol yal-laj eyak'an wino silab'il yuj eyik'ancha'anh Jehová, manh ol schalaj he silab' ta'. Ha tas ol he wa'a, icha tas swaji ayik ay chamel, yuj chi' a mach ol wa'anok, ol kan chukal t'a yichanh ley. Ol yal yek' swejel heb' yuj, palta manh ol yal-laj yik'anb'at heb' t'a stemplo Jehová.
Manhxo ol yal eyak'an k'inh, juntzanh k'inh yik Jehová.

Ol ex el lemnaj t'a jun yahelal ol jawok. Haxo heb' aj Egipto ol ex molanb'atok. Ha t'a chonhab' Menfis ol ex mukchaj yuj heb'. Ha b'aj molb'il k'e'en he plata ayoch he b'eyumalok yet' b'aj ix ex ek' kajan, ol k'ib'k'e anh ank'ultak, nab'a k'i'ix ol ajkanok.

Ex wetisraelal, wan sjawi sk'uhal sjawi yahelal. Ol nachajel eyu'uj to toxo ix k'och sk'uhal yik tze cha he tojol icha smojalil. Tzeyal icha tik: Ha heb' schekab' Dios, te malaj spensar heb'. Ha heb' kuchb'ab'il yuj Yespíritu Dios toxo ix och heb' loko'al, xe chi. Tzeyal icha chi', yujto tz'alchaj he chukal yuj heb', yuj chi' schichon he k'o'ol t'a heb'.
Ha Dios ix yak'och heb' schekab' ex stanhwej ex aj Efraín, palta tze b'o'em ya'al t'a yoltak sb'e heb' he tanhwumal chi'. Inatax t'a stemplo Dios schichon he k'o'ol t'a heb'.
Ix ex ixtaxel t'a junelnhej, icha ix uji t'a chonhab' Gabaa. Palta haxo Jehová ol snakot he chukal chi', ol ak'chajoch yahelal t'a eyib'anh yuj he mul chi'.

Syal Jehová icha tik: Ayik ix in chalan in b'a yet' heb' israel, ix in te tzalaji, icha mach tz'ilchaj te' uwa yuj t'a tzinan lu'um. Ha heb' he mam eyicham, icha te' sat higo te nib'ab'il spet eluli, icha chi' ajnak heb' t'a yol in sat. Haxo sk'ochnak heb' t'a chonhab' Peor, yoch heb' ejmelal t'a Baal sdiosal jun chonhab' chi', te yajb'entak yutejnak sb'a heb' icha jun komon Dios xajanejnak heb' chi'.
Ha sniwanil yelk'och chonhab' Efraín, tonhej ol satk'e icha sb'at jenhnaj junok nok' much. Manhxa unin ol aljok t'ay, manhxa heb' ix ix ol och yab'ixal, manhxalaj pax heb' ix ol skuchoch yune'.
Tato ay b'aj ol k'ib' heb' unin chi', a inxo ol wik'el sk'inal heb', manhxo junok ol wak'kani. Ob'iltak juntzanh anima chi' ayik ol wik'anel in b'a t'a heb'.
Ayik ix wilan heb' aj Efraín, lajan icha junok te' palma awab'il b'aj te yax sat, icha chi' yaj heb' ix wila'. Palta a tikne'ik, ol yik'elta yuninal heb' yik smak'jichamok, xchi Jehová.

Mamin Jehová, ¿Tas smoj tzin k'an t'ayach to tzak' t'a juntzanh anima tik? Wach' hama, tato malaj yune' heb' ix ix. Tato ay heb' ix ay yune' jun, wach' hama to malaj yal yim heb' ix yik maxtzak yak' chunok yune' heb' ix chi'.

Ix yalan Jehová icha tik: T'a Gilgal ix cha'el yich sk'ulan chukal heb', yuj chi' a pax ta' ix el yich woch ajk'olal t'a heb'. Yuj masanil chukal sk'ulej heb', yuj chi' ol wik'elta heb' t'a lum in lu'um ix wak' t'a heb'. Manhxo ol in xajanej heb', yujto smasanil heb' yajal heb', te pit.
Ha chonhab' Efraín echenxo yaji. Lajan icha junok te te' toxo ix takji sch'anhal yip, maxtzak yak' sat. Wach'chom ay yuninal heb', a inxo ol wak'cham yuninal heb' chi' to xajanab'il yuj, xchi Jehová.
Ha jun chonhab' tik, max cha yab' heb' tas syal in Diosal. Yuj chi' a ol patikanel heb', haxo t'a skal juntzanh ch'ok chonhab'il ol saklemkanb'at heb'.

Ex wetisraelal, lajan ex icha jun ib'ok te' uwa te ay sat yiknhej sch'okoj. Icha satan te' uwa chi', icha chi' eyaltar ix he b'ok'e'i. Haxo ix ex te och b'eyumal, ix he wach' b'o'ej eyaltar chi' b'aj tzeyal he b'a t'a juntzanh he komon diosal chi'.
Ha ex tik, chapoj yaj he pixan. Haxo tikne'ik, ol he tupel he chukal chi'. Ha Jehová ol juanem masanil eyaltar chi', ol sjuanpaxem juntzanh yechel he diosal chi'.
Yuj chi' ol eyal icha tik: Malaj ko reyal, yujto malaj yelk'och Jehová t'a yol ko sat. Palta, ¿tasto wal tz'och junok rey chi' ku'uj? xe chama.

Anhej lolonel tzeyak'a', tzeyak'an he ti' t'a es. Ayik tze ch'olb'itan tas yaj heb' anima, manh tojolok tzeyutej. Ha tze b'o'an tas yaj heb' anima chi', lajan icha junok owal ank'ultak sk'ib'k'e t'a kal munlajel.

Ha heb' aj Samaria ol luklon heb' yuj xiwelal, ol yalan heb': ¿Tas ol utaj ko diosal? xcham heb'. Ha jun wakax sdiosal heb' ay t'a Bet-awén ol ik'chajb'at t'a chonhab' Asiria, yik tz'ak'chaj t'a winh rey niwan yelk'ochi. Yuj chi' ol kus heb' chonhab', ol ok' heb' yet' heb' sacerdote, yujto a swach'ilal yilji jun chi', toxo ix sateli. Icha chi' ol kan chonhab' Efraín t'a k'ixwelal yujto ix yal sb'a t'a jun yechel wakax chi'.
Ol satel chonhab' Samaria yet' sreyal, icha sb'atkan b'akhachok junok k'ajil te' t'a yib'anh ha ha'.

Ol lajwokem stemplo sdiosal heb' ch'ok chonhab'il, haton juntzanh b'aj ix och chonhab' Israel t'a chukalil. Ol k'ib'k'e te' k'i'ix b'aj ay yaltar heb' chi'. Ol yalan heb' yuj lum witz yet' yuj lum tzalan icha tik: Komonok syal skot juynaj t'a kib'anh yik tzonh sk'ub'ejeli, xcham heb'.
Ix yalan Jehová icha tik: Ha ex israel ex tik, ix he cha'el yich he k'ulan chukal t'a Gabaa, hanheja' icha chi' tze k'ulej tikne'ik. Yuj chi' ol ex satel yuj owal t'a Gabaa chi'.
Ha in ol in na b'ak'inh ol wak'och yahelal yib'anh jun chonhab' tik. Ayik ol wak'anoch yahelal chi' yuj jantak schukal sk'ulej, ol och hoyan juntzanh chonhab' t'a spatik yak'an owal yet'ok.

Ha t'a yalanhtaxo, lajan chonhab' Efraín icha junok nok' wakax k'aynakxo smunlaji, sk'anab'ajej stek'wi trigo. Haxo tikne'ik a heb' aj Judá yet' juntzanhxo heb' yinhtil Jacob ol yab' sya'il heb' icha junok nok' wakax b'aj tz'och te' yugo t'a sjaj yik smunlaj nok' t'okoj lu'um yet' skalan lum yet' k'e'en rastrillo.

Ha ex tik lajan ex icha junok lu'um aktab'ilkani, manhxa mach smunlaj t'ay. Palta haxo tikne'ik b'o'ek he b'eyb'al icha tz'aj yawchajxi tas t'a jun lum aktab'ilkan chi'. Ha tas ol eyawej, a tojolal, haxo tas ol he jach'a' haton b'aj tzex in xajanej. Smojxo tzeyak'och he b'a t'a yol in k'ab', masanto ol in jawok wak' he kolnab'il icha yem nhab'.

Palta a ex xo tik anhej chukal tze k'ulej, yuj chi' wan he cha'an spak tas manh tojolok tze k'ulej chi'. Wan he cha'an spak he lek'ti'al. Yujto ix eyak'och he carruaje yik owal yet' heb' he soldado tzijtum sb'isul yipok he k'o'ol,
yuj chi' ol k'e somnaj masanil heb' soldado chi', ol satel he cuartel icha ix aj satel chonhab' Bet-arbel yuj winhaj rey Salmán. T'a jun owal chi', ix mak'chaj chojok heb' ix nunab'il yet' yune'.
Ex aj Betel, icha chi' ol ex utaj yuj jantak he chukal. Ha winh he reyal ol b'ab'laj cham t'a k'inhib'alil, xchi Jehová.
Ix yal Jehová icha tik: Ayik unin chonhab'to Israel tik, ix in xajanej. Icha wuninal yaji, hato t'a Egipto ix wawtejkoti.
Ayik ix wawtankot chi', te najat ix el t'a in tz'ey. Ha t'a juntzanh Dios Baal ix yak' silab' jun in chonhab' tik. Ix snhus incienso heb' t'a juntzanh yechel.
Ayik unin chonhab'to Efraín tik, ichato ix in chelb'eyok. Wach'chom icha chi', palta max yal sk'o'ol heb' sna'a tato a in tzin tanhwej heb'.

Ix in ketzkot Efraín chi' yujto xajan wu'uj, icha tz'aj sketzchaj junok nok' wakax. Lajan swutej icha junok mach tz'ik'anel yugo t'a nok' wakax, wach' tz'aj yak'an swa'el. Icha chi' ix wutej in b'a t'a heb'.
Palta manh jab'ok ix in yak'och heb' yipok sk'o'ol. Ha Egipto ix yak'och heb' yipok sk'o'ol, palta yuj chi' t'a yalanh smandar chonhab' Asiria ol kanok.
Ol och owal t'a schonhab' heb'. Yuj owal chi' ol em juynaj scuartel heb'. Ol satel heb' yujto ix yak'och sjelanil heb' yipok sk'o'ol.
Ha in chonhab' tik na'an yuj to tz'elkan t'a in patik yik syal sb'a t'a juntzanh komon Dios. Wach'chom tz'awaj heb' sk'anan kolwal t'a juntzanh komon Dios chi', palta manh ol kolwajlaj t'a heb'.

¿Tas wal ol aj ex waktankan ex chonhab' Efraín? ¿Tas wal ol aj ex waktankan ex yinhtilal Israel? ¿Ol am yal ex wak'an satel icha ix wutej chonhab' Adma? ¿Ol am ex wutej icha ix wutej chonhab' Zeboim? Ya syab' in pixan, skus in k'ol eyu'uj.

Manh ol in k'ulejlaj ichawal yowal in k'o'ol. Manh ol in meltzajlaj ex wak'an satel ex chonhab' Efraín, yujto Dios in, manh in anima'ok. Ayinek' heyet'ok Ha inxonhej Ochi, yuj chi' manh ol in jawok ex in sateli.
Ha in Jehová in ol el waw icha junok nok' choj. Yuj chi' ol te ib'xok heb' wuninal yuj xiwelal, ol kot heb' t'a b'aj tz'em k'u, ol och tzak'an heb' wu'uj.
Ol kot lemnaj heb' t'a Egipto yet' t'a Asiria icha nok' kuwajte'. Ha in Jehová in swala', ol wak' kajnaj heb' junelxo t'a skajnub' junjun.

Ha chonhab' Efraín yinhtil Israel, anhej es sk'ulej t'a wichanh. T'a chab'satil syal sb'a t'ayin. Haxo heb' aj Judá, te pit syutej sb'a heb' t'ayin, a in sDiosal in heb' Ha inxonhej Ochi, tz'elnhejk'och tas swala'.

Masanil tas sk'ulej chonhab' Efraín, nab'anhej. Tonhej syixtejb'at sb'a. Ste k'ewal cha'anh t'a ixtoj anima. Komonxonhej sb'o strato yet' heb' aj Asiria, syak'anpaxb'at aceite heb' yik smontan Egipto, xchi Jehová.
Ha heb' aj Judá ay smul heb' t'a yol sat Jehová chi'. Ha ol ak'anoch yahelal t'a schonhab' winhaj Jacob yuj sb'eyb'al. Ol stup t'a heb', icha wal tas sb'eyb'alej heb'.
Inatax ayik manto aljok winhaj Jacob chi', syamnak yich yok winh yuk'tak winh, haxo yik icham winakxo winh, stelajnak sb'a winh yet' Dios.

Stelajnak sb'a winh yet' Dios yet' jun ángel, masanto yak'nak ganar jun ángel chi' winh. Ok'nak winh, sk'anannak swach'k'olal Dios winh t'a yib'anh. Ha t'a Betel sch'oxnak sb'a Dios t'a winh, lolonnak winh yet' ta'.
Ha Jehová Yajal t'a Smasanil, haton sb'i b'inajnak.
Palta a ex israel ex tik, meltzajanhek t'a ko Diosal. k'anab'ajum tzeyutej he b'a t'ay, tojolnhej tzeyutej he b'eyb'al. Ayokab'nhej och yipok he k'o'ol.
Icha tik yalan Jehová: Ha heb' chonhwajum yik Efraín, a echlab' manh tz'akanok sk'an heb', yujto scham wal heb' yelk'ani.

Syal heb' icha tik: Wach'chom toxo onh och b'eyumal, wach'chom b'eyum onhxo, palta malaj mach syal skot yowal t'ayonh, yik syalan heb' to onh och b'eyumal yuj kak'an musansatil heb' anima, xchi heb', xchi Jehová.
Syalanxi Jehová chi' icha tik: Ha in Jehová in, atax yik ayex ek' t'a Egipto he Diosal in. Ol ex wak' kajnaj junelxo t'a yoltak mantiado, icha t'a juntzanh k'uhal ayik molan ex ek' t'a tzinan lu'um.
Ha in tik ix in lolon t'a heb' in chekab'. Tzijtum sb'isul tas ix wak' yil heb'. Ha heb' chi' ix wak' alanel in k'ayb'ub'al t'a ch'oxnab'ilal.

Ha t'a Galaad ay sdiosal heb' ch'ok chonhab'il, palta manhxa jab'ok yelk'och ol ajkanok. Ha t'a Gilgal syak' nok' wakax heb' t'a silab'il, palta lajanxo ol ajkan yaltar heb' icha k'e'en k'e'en molb'ilk'e b'ulan t'a kal munlajel, xchi Jehová.
Ha winhaj Jacob, b'atnakkan winh elelal t'a yoltak yik Aram. Hata' ochnak winh t'a tanhwoj kalnel yuj yik'an ix yetb'eyum winh.
Ha yet' jun schekab' yik'nakelta chonhab' Israel Jehová t'a Egipto. Hanheja' yet' jun schekab' chi', stanhwejnhej.

Palta a wal anima yik Efraín, ix stzuntzejkot yowal sk'ol Jehová heb'. Ix yak' chab'ax sk'ol heb'. Yuj chi' ol yak' Jehová chi' stupel heb' jantak chukal ix sk'ulej, hanheja' yuj schukal heb' chi' ol em t'a yib'anh.

Ayik slolonnak heb' yichamtak winakil chonhab' Efraín t'a peka', haxo juntzanhxo yinhtilal Israel ch'oxannak to ay yelk'och t'a yol sat heb'. Haxo tikne'ik, ol cham heb' aj Efraín chi' yuj smul ix yak'ochi, ix och heb' ejmelal t'a Baal.

Tzato k'enhej cha'anh heb' yak'anoch smul. Sb'ok'e k'e'en plata heb' sdiosalok, icha wal tas snib'ej sk'o'ol heb', icha pax tas skot t'a spensar heb', icha chi' syutej heb' sb'o'an sdiosal. Slajwi chi' syalanpaxk'e heb': Hak'ek he silab' t'ay, xchi heb'. Haxo heb' anima jun, stz'ub'elta sti' jun yechel heb' lajan yilji icha wakax chi'.

Yuj chi' lajannhej ol aj heb' icha asun ayemi ayik sk'inhib'i, icha pax yal ak'wal ayemi ayik te ak'walto to spet satemi. Lajan pax heb' icha matz'il trigo tz'ik'chajb'at yuj ik', ma icha te tab' tz'el t'a junok wentena.
Ix yalan Jehová icha tik: Ha in Jehová he Diosal in, atax yik ayex ek' t'a Egipto, malaj junokxo tas tzeyak'och he diosalok, palta a innhej. Ha innhej he Kolumal waji.
Te wach' ajnak ex in tanhwan t'a takinh lu'um, b'aj te ay k'ak'.
Palta a wal yik ix yak'an sobre he wa'el, ix he te ik'ejcha'anh he b'a, ix in b'atkan satk'olal eyu'uj.
Yuj chi' icha junok nok' choj ol wutej in b'a t'ayex, ma icha junok nok' tz'ib'choj smakwaj t'a yoltak b'e.

Ol in elta juknaj t'a eyichanh, icha junok nok' nun oso to toxo ix ik'chajb'at yune'. Ol ex wak'an chok'b'okb'at ta', icha junok nok' choj schi'anb'at schib'ej, ma icha tz'aj schok' jekchitanb'at schib'ej junok nok' chi'um nok'.
Ol ex wak' satel a ex israel ex tik, malaj mach ol yal stenanek'i.
Ix he k'an he reyal yet' he kuchb'umal, palta ¿tom a heb' syal tanhwan masanil he chonhab' tik?
Aykot wowal t'ayex ayik ix wak'an he reyal chi', hanheja' aypaxkot wowal t'ayex ayik ix wik'anpaxek' heb' he reyal chi'.
Chekel yaj schukal chonhab' Efraín. Tz'ib' ix ajkan smul chi'.
Ha chonhab' Israel, sk'och sk'uhal yik sna sb'a, palta te malaj spensar, icha junok unin manh wach'ok syutej sayankot sb'a ayik tz'alji t'a snun, icha chi' yaji.
Ol in kolkanel in chonhab' t'a yol slumal chamel. Ol in kolkanel t'a yol sk'ab' chamel. Ha in ol wak' satel chamub'. Manhxo ol in ch'ox wok'elk'olal t'a chonhab' Efraín chi'.

Wach'chom sk'enhejcha'anh t'a skal heb' yetisraelal, palta ol kot wowal t'ay. Lajan ol aj skot wowal chi' icha k'ak' t'a yichcha'anh, icha yek' chakxuxum ik' t'a tzinan lu'um, yuj chi' ol tup sjajtak ha ha', haxo heb' ajk'o'ol ol ik'anb'at masanil sb'eyumal.
Ha chonhab' Samaria ol yik' pax syahelal, yujto pit syutej sb'a t'ayin. Ol cham heb' yuj k'e'en espada. Ha yuninal heb' ol tenchajem t'a sat lu'um chi', xchi Jehová.
Ex wetisraelal, meltzajanhek t'a Jehová ko Diosal, wach'chom ix ex telwi wal yuj he mul.
Meltzajanhekxi t'a Jehová, tzex tewi t'ay icha tik: Ak' tup ko mul, tza cha'an kejmelal yet' ko aloj wach' lolonel skal t'ayach.

Ha Asiria max yal ko kolji'el yuj. ¿Tok wal syal pax ko kolchajel yuj nok' chej? Manhxo ol kaloch juntzanh tas sko b'o ko diosalok, yujto anhej wal t'ayach ach Jehová syik' sniwanil sk'ol heb' unin manhxa smam snun, xe chi.
Syalan Jehová icha tik: Ol wak' ja spensar heb' t'a spitalil. Wach'chom manh smojok, palta ol in xajanej heb', yujto manhxo ol wak'kot yowal in k'ol t'a heb'.
Ichawal tz'aj xumakil anh chochol yuj yal ak'wal, ma icha te' k'ute' t'a sjolomtak witzal Líbano to najat sb'at sch'anhal yib', icha chi' ol wutej heb' israel.
Yuj chi' te wach' ix aj yel mayan icha wal sk'ab'tak te' olivo, lajan pax sjab' icha wal sjab' te' k'ute' t'a Líbano.
Ol in yak'xi'och heb' yipok sk'o'ol. Wach'xo ol aj sk'ib' icha sk'ib' ixim trigo, wach'xonhej xumakan icha te' uwa. Te b'inajnak ol aj ichawal wino skot t'a Líbano chi'.

Ex aj Efraín, ¿tok ay yopisio juntzanh komon Dios chi'? Ha in ol in tak'wok t'ayex, ol ex in tanhwejpaxi. Icha junok te' taj yax xi'il, icha chi' waj eyu'uj. Wu'uj wal, wach' tzex elk'ochi, xchi Jehová.
Ha heb' jelan yet' heb' aj pensar ol nachajel juntzanh in lolonel tik yuj heb'. Ha sb'e Jehová, te tojol. Ha heb' wach' spensar, a heb' sb'at t'a yol jun b'e chi', haxo heb' te pit, stelwi heb' t'ay.
